data.displayName: Origin Go Variable Ongoing - New & Move Customers only

fees.description: A $56.72 (GST Incl) fee may apply when your property is reconnected (including when you move). Fee may vary.
A $56.72 (GST Incl) fee may apply when your property is disconnected (including when you move). Fee may vary.
A fee of up to $0.00 (GST Incl) may apply when your property is disconnected for non-payment. Fee may vary.
A fee of $15.00 (GST exempt) may apply if your bill is not paid by the due date.
If you pay at an Australia Post outlet, a payment processing fee of the higher of $2.70 or 0.49% (incl GST) may apply.
$2.15 (incl GST) may apply for each paper bill.

electricityContract.terms: By signing up to this plan you agree to us sharing your email address with TLC Marketing Worldwide Australia & NZ for the purposes of them emailing you in relation to the Uber Eats Voucher.They will handle your personal information in accordance with their privacy policy.This offer is in no way sponsored or administered by Uber Eats. Offer not available in all areas or properties connecting for first time. Residential customers only. Visit originenergy.com.au/2889/Terms-and-conditions for more.
electricityContract.variation: We may vary the Charges (including their amount, nature and structure) by notice to you at any time. For increases, notice will be at least 10 business days prior, for decreases, the notice will be at least 5 business days prior to the effective date.

incentives.description: You will receive a $200 Uber Eats voucher if your account remains active for 45 days and you haven't received a credit for electricity at that address in the previous 12 months.Voucher is redeemable in five $40 voucher amounts, each valid for 30 days.Offer and Uber voucher terms and conditions apply.

greenPowerCharges.description: For 2.25 cents/kWh 50% of your electricity usage is matched with electricity from Government accredited GreenPower sources

electricityContract.additionalFeeInformation: You may be required to pay any amounts that a Distributor or Meter Service Provider charges us for services provided at your Supply Address, including any metering-related goods or services, and which are not already incorporated into the Supply Charges or Energy Usage Charges.
